description: Ministry of Environment Monitoring of Rivers, Lakes, and Water Reservoirs is a dataset listed in Open Data Armenia, an open data portal (CKAN) run by a civil-society initiative, published or maintained by Open Data Armenia. Daily (on workdays) published pdf files with data (in tables) on inflow and outflow, as well as water level for Lake Sevan, volumes of the largest reservoirs, and daily outflows for the rivers measured twice a day. Coverage: Open Data Armenia. The publisher named on the listing is Open Data Armenia. Its keywords include ecology, natural resources, parsing-needed, water resources. The listing shows 5 download or service links in ZIP, XLSX. The listing shows 2023-04-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Other (Public Domain). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-opendata-am.
